===== Components/ButtonView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct ButtonView: View {
  enum Size: String, CaseIterable {
    case sm, lg
  }
  var size: Size = .sm
  var label: String = "Button"
  var showIcon: Bool = true

  var body: some View {
    switch (size) {
    case (.lg):
      HStack(spacing: 8) {
        if showIcon {
          Ellipse()
            .fill(Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1))
            .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
        }
        Text(label)
          .font(.custom("Inter", size: 16))
          .fontWeight(.semibold)
          .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1))
          .lineSpacing(4.8)
          .fixedSize()
        Spacer(minLength: 0)
      }
        .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 12, leading: 20, bottom: 12, trailing: 20))
        .background(Color.colorBrand)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
    default:
      HStack(spacing: 8) {
        if showIcon {
          Ellipse()
            .fill(Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1))
            .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
        }
        Text(label)
          .font(.custom("Inter", size: 14))
          .fontWeight(.semibold)
          .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1))
          .lineSpacing(4.2)
          .fixedSize()
        Spacer(minLength: 0)
      }
        .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 8, leading: 12, bottom: 8, trailing: 12))
        .background(Color.colorBrand)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
    }
  }
}

#Preview {
  ButtonView()
}
===== Components/CardView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct CardView: View {
  var content: AnyView = AnyView(EmptyView())
  var title: String = "Card title"

  var body: some View {
    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
      Text(title)
        .font(.custom("Inter", size: 20))
        .fontWeight(.semibold)
        .foregroundStyle(Color.colorText)
        .lineSpacing(6)
        .fixedSize()
      content
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
      Spacer(minLength: 0)
    }
      .padding(16)
      .frame(width: 320)
      .background(Color.colorSurface)
      .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12).strokeBorder(Color(red: 0.894, green: 0.894, blue: 0.906), lineWidth: 1))
      .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
      .shadow(color: Color(red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0, opacity: 0.122), radius: 8, x: 0, y: 4)
  }
}

#Preview {
  CardView()
}
===== Screens/HomeView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct HomeView: View {
  // Breakpoint variants of this screen are not exported to SwiftUI: (max-width: 478px)
  var body: some View {
    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
      HStack(spacing: .spaceMd) {
        Text("Acme")
          .font(.custom("Inter", size: 20))
          .fontWeight(.bold)
          .foregroundStyle(Color.colorText)
          .lineSpacing(6)
          .fixedSize()
        Spacer(minLength: 0)
        ButtonView(size: .lg, label: "Sign up", showIcon: false)
      }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
      Text("Build faster\nwith components")
        .font(.custom("Inter", size: 48))
        .fontWeight(.bold)
        .foregroundStyle(Color.colorText)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
      Grid(horizontalSpacing: 24, verticalSpacing: 24) {
        GridRow {
          CardView(title: "Fast", content: AnyView(Text("Lays out like CSS.").font(.custom("Inter", size: 14)).foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0.322, green: 0.322, blue: 0.357)).lineSpacing(4.2).fixedSize()))
          CardView(title: "Open")
        }
      }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
      Spacer(minLength: 0)
    }
      .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 48, leading: 64, bottom: 48, trailing: 64))
      .frame(width: 1280)
      .background(Color.colorSurface)
  }
}

===== Screens/SettingsView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct SettingsView: View {
  var body: some View {
    ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
      Color.clear
        .frame(width: 74, height: 24)
        .background(LinearGradient(stops: [.init(color: Color(red: 0.388, green: 0.4, blue: 0.945), location: 0), .init(color: Color(red: 0.659, green: 0.333, blue: 0.969), location: 1)], startPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0, y: 0.5), endPoint: UnitPoint(x: 1, y: 0.5)))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        .offset(x: 300, y: 16)
        .accessibilityLabel("New")
      Image("avatar")
        .resizable()
        .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fill)
        .frame(width: 64, height: 64)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 32))
        .offset(x: 16, y: 16)
        .accessibilityLabel("Profile photo")
      Image("arrow")
        .resizable()
        .frame(width: 24, height: 24)
        .offset(x: 16, y: 100)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
      Text("Settings are saved automatically.")
        .font(.custom("Inter", size: 12))
        .foregroundStyle(Color.colorText)
        .kerning(0.5)
        .textCase(.uppercase)
        .lineSpacing(3.6)
        .fixedSize()
        .offset(x: 16, y: 140)
    }
      .frame(width: 390, height: 600)
      .background(Color(red: 0.98, green: 0.98, blue: 0.98))
      .clipped()
  }
}

  SettingsView()
}
===== Tokens.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's variables. Do not edit by hand.
import SwiftUI

extension Color {
  /// A color with a light and a dark value (follows the system appearance).
  init(light: Color, dark: Color) {
    #if canImport(UIKit)
    self.init(uiColor: UIColor { $0.userInterfaceStyle == .dark ? UIColor(dark) : UIColor(light) })
    #else
    self = light
    #endif
  }

  static let colorBrand = Color(light: Color(red: 0.31, green: 0.275, blue: 0.898), dark: Color(red: 0.506, green: 0.549, blue: 0.973))
  static let colorSurface = Color(light: Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1), dark: Color(red: 0.094, green: 0.094, blue: 0.106))
  static let colorText = Color(light: Color(red: 0.094, green: 0.094, blue: 0.106), dark: Color(red: 0.98, green: 0.98, blue: 0.98))
}

extension CGFloat {
  static let spaceMd: CGFloat = 16
}
